verdicts.tldr: a named result `cur realm` is refused whenever the enclosing function's first realm parameter is blank, the one member of the class this PR's fix 2 leaves behind
verdicts.details: Both arms of isCrossingCurParam ask only getType(&dbn.Type).(*FuncType).IsCrossing(), and IsCrossing (types.go:1393) compares Params[0].Type to gRealmType and nothing else. A named result `cur` is declared in the FuncDecl's own block, so GetBlockNodeForPath resolves it to that FuncDecl and the function answers true for a result it is documented to leave alone. The shape is reachable because a blank first parameter is renamed to `.arg_0` (preprocess.go:557) and the FuncTypeExpr crossing-name rule accepts any `.arg` prefix (preprocess.go:2827), so `func F(_ realm) (cur realm)` is a well-formed crossing function. The user loses a legal program: `cur = nil` in its body is rejected at preprocess with a message that names the result as this frame's realm identity, while the ADR's Decision, isCrossingCurParam's own godoc and the new zrealm_cur_other_legal.gno all say a named result stays writable. That fixture covers only the non-crossing enclosing form `func namedResult(x int) (cur realm)`. Fix: gate both arms on the first parameter actually carrying the name, `ft.IsCrossing() && ft.Params[0].Name == "cur"`.
verdicts.evidence: My own runs, scratch worktrees detached at each sha. Head 6d88deba7, finder's artifact copied to gnovm/tests/files/zrealm_b2claims_namedresult.gno: `--- FAIL: TestFiles/zrealm_b2claims_namedresult.gno` / `files_test.go:135: unexpected panic: gno.land/r/demo/curnamedres/zrealm_b2claims_namedresult.gno:27:2-11: cannot reassign the crossing `cur` parameter: it names the realm this frame is executing as, and that binding is fixed for the life of the frame` (line 27 is the `cur = nil` inside `func namedResult(_ realm) (cur realm)`). Merge base b7845fb2d, same fixture: byte-identical panic at the same position, so the case space is both-fail, not head-only. With `ft.Params[0].Name == "cur"` added to both arms at head: fixture `ok github.com/gnolang/gno/gnovm/pkg/gnolang 0.053s`, and `go test ./gnovm/pkg/gnolang/ -run 'TestFiles/zrealm_cur_.*\.gno$' -v` gives 31 PASS subtests and `ok ... 1.223s`, no fixture regressing.
